items.title: Steps of crystallization (print mein 15.4.1) (crystallization ke steps) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Steps of crystallization, printed as 15.4.1 with Figure 15.5 and Quick Check 15.2, pages 327-328.

items: Experiment ke temperature par suitable solvent mein substance ka saturated solution (jis mein aur substance hal na ho sake) banayen.

Phir garam saturated solution ko filter kar ke insoluble impurities (jo hal nahi hoti) nikal dein. Garam filter karne se solute waqt se pehle (premature) filter paper ya funnel ki nali (stem) mein crystals nahi banata. Zaroorat ho to is ke liye hot water funnel istemal karein.
Garam filter kiye solution ko moderate rate (darmiyani speed) se thanda karein taake darmiyane size ke crystals banein.
Jab crystallization complete ho jaye to crystals aur mother liquor (bacha hua solution) ke mixture ko vacuum pump ke saath Gooch crucible se filter karein.
Crystals hawa mein ya oven mein sukhaye ja sakte hain. Oven mein sirf tab sukhayen jab substance 100° C par garam hone se na pighle aur na toote (decompose ho).

blocks.title: Keep in Mind! (yaad rakhein)
blocks.text: Kabhi kabhi kachcha (crude) substance banate waqt rang dene wali cheezen ya resin jaise substance product ki shakal kharab kar dete hain. Inhen hatane ke liye substance ko solvent mein kafi amount ke bareek pise animal charcoal ke saath ubala jata hai, phir garam solution filter kiya jata hai. Rangeen impurities charcoal ki surface par chipak (adsorb ho) jati hain, aur thanda hone par filtrate se pure, be-rang substance crystals ban kar nikalta hai.

blocks.alt: Baayen se daayen paanch steps: beaker mein ek solid aur insoluble impurity wala solution; funnel aur filter paper se evaporating dish mein filter karna; tripod par burner se garam kar ke volume kam karna; garam liquid ko chapti dish mein dalna; thanda hone par crystals banna.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Crystallization ke different steps (kitab ki Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Picture baayen se daayen parhein: (1) beaker mein ek solid ka solution aur na hal hone wali impurity; (2) filter kar ke extra solid alag; (3) evaporating dish mein garam kar ke solution ka volume kam karna; (4) garam liquid dish mein dalna; (5) thanda chhorne par saturated solution se crystals banna.

Crystals sukhane ka safe aur reliable (bharose wala) tareeqa vacuum desiccator hai. Is mein crystals ko watch glass par phaila kar kai ghante vacuum desiccator mein rakha jata hai. Desiccator mein drying agents (nami choosne wali cheezen) CaCl₂, silica gel ya phosphorus pentoxide hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Figure 15.9' likhti hai, lekin Figure 15.9 paper chromatography (ascending aur descending) ki picture hai. Kitab mein vacuum desiccator ki koi picture nahi.

blocks.prompt: a) Crystallization ka basic principle kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Solute suitable solvent mein zyada temperature par hal ho jata hai; solution thanda karne par extra solute crystals ki shakal mein nikal aata hai aur impurities solution mein reh jati hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Crystallization ke liye suitable (munasib) solvent kaise chuna jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Aisa solvent chunte hain jo boiling point par substance ki zyada aur room temperature par kam amount hal kare, us se react na kare, impurities ko alag rakhe, thanda hone par achhe crystals de, aur sasta, safe aur aasani se hatne wala ho. Aam misalen: pani, absolute ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride, acetic acid.

blocks.prompt: c) Crystallization ke important step batayein.
blocks.explanation: Saturated garam solution banana; garam filtration (zaroorat ho to hot water funnel); aahista thanda karna; Gooch crucible aur vacuum pump se crystals ko mother liquor se filter karna; hawa, oven ya vacuum desiccator mein sukhana. Rangeen impurities animal charcoal ke saath ubal kar hatai jati hain.

items: Step: saturated garam solution; garam filtration; aahista thanda; Gooch crucible mein suction filtration; sukhana (hawa, 100° C oven, ya CaCl₂, silica gel, P₂O₅ wala vacuum desiccator).
Animal charcoal rangeen impurities ko adsorb kar ke hata deta hai.
